book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Amiija igʉrʉ wʉ ʉkʉtɨnɨra abhandɨ
“Mʉtatɨnɨra abhandɨ, korereke mʉtaaza kutinirwa na Mungu.
Chɨmbu mʉkʉtɨnɨra abhandɨ, nɨmbu imwʉsi mʉraatinirwɨ. Ne ekerengo kɨnʉ mokorengera abhandɨ, necho mʉraarengerwe.
“Ndora ʉrarora ekebhereera kɨnʉ kiri muriisʉ ryʉ ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ, nawe ʉtakorora ɨkɨtɨnɨka kɨnʉ kiri muriisʉ ryazʉ?
Kisha ʉratʉrabhwɨ kʉbhʉʉrɨra ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ, ‘Tiga nikuruushɨ ekebhereera muriisʉ ryazʉ,’ nawe ʉtakorora ɨkɨtɨnɨka muriisʉ ryazʉ?
Ʉmʉbhɨɨhi awɨ! Ruusha hinga ɨkɨtɨnɨka muriisʉ ryazʉ. Neho ʉkʉtʉra korora bhwaheene na kuruusha ekebhereera muriisʉ ryʉ ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ.
“Mʉtaha zimbwa ebhegero ɨbhɨrɨndu, korereke zɨtaaza kwichʉra zɨbhanyamʉrɨ. Na mʉtataashirya zingurubhɨ ebhegero bhyu ubhwera, zɨtaaza kʉbhɨtazataza.
Amiija igʉrʉ wu ukwisasaama Mungu
“Mʉsabhɨ Mungu, na niimwɨ mʉrahaabhwa. Momohye, na niimwɨ mʉrabhona. Muhunɨ ikisikʉ, na niimwɨ muriigurirwa.
Wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akʉsabha, arahaabhwa. Wʉnʉ akomohya, arabhona, na wʉnʉ akuhuna ikisikʉ, ariigurirwa.
“Nangʉ, wɨɨwɨ gatɨ waanyu, wʉnʉ umwana waazɨ araasabhɨ ʉmʉkaatɨ, aramoha riibhwɨ?
Hamwɨ araasabhɨ iiswɨ, aramoha enzoka?
Arɨɨbhɨ imwɨ abhabhɨ, mwɨzɨ kʉbhaha abhaana bhaanyu ebhegero ɨbhɨzʉmu. Wuusʉ wa mwisaarʉ atakʉtʉra kʉbhaha amazʉmu kʉkɨraho, bhanʉ bhakʉmʉsabha?
“Mmbe, mokorere abhandɨ ganʉ mukwenda mokorerwe. Yiyo neyo enzobhooro yi imigirʉ ja Musa na amiija ga abharʉʉtɨrɨri.
Kusikɨra mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu
“Musikɨrɨ kʉhɨtɨra ikisikʉ ikigutɨ. Ikishoko ɨkɨgarɨ nɨ ɨnzɨra ɨngarɨ bhiyo bhɨrahira ʉmʉʉtʉ kurichwa. Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakʉhɨtɨra iyo, nɨ‑bhaaru.
Nawe ikishoko kɨnʉ kikwerekera kʉbhʉhʉru, ni‑kigutɨ, nɨ ɨnzɨra yu ukwerekera iyo, ni‑ngutɨ. Na bhanʉ bhakoyerora, nɨ‑bhasuuhu.
Kwobhoora abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ
“Mwiyangarɨrɨ na abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ. Hanʉ bhakubhaazaku, bhararorekana ncha zɨngʼʉndu, nawe nɨ‑bhahaari ncha zisuuzɨ.
Mʉrabhamenya kumisumʉ jabhʉ. Awɨɨ abhaatʉ bhahaatwa zɨzabhiibhu kʉmɨtɨ ja amahwa, hamwɨ imisumʉ ju umutiini komesonkoma?
Ʉmʉtɨ ʉmʉzʉmu gwahiibhʉra imisumʉ ɨmɨzʉmu, nawe ʉmʉtɨ ʉmʉbhɨ guhiibhʉra imisumʉ ɨmɨbhɨ.
Ʉmʉtɨ ʉmʉzʉmu gʉtakʉtʉra kwibhʉra imisumʉ ɨmɨbhɨ, nʉ ʉmʉtɨ ʉmʉbhɨ gʉtakʉtʉra kwibhʉra imisumʉ ɨmɨzʉmu.
Ɨmɨtɨ jʉsi gɨnʉ gɨtakwibhʉra imisumʉ ɨmɨzʉmu, gɨhaatinwa na kʉtaashwa momorero.
Ɨbhuɨbhu na abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ, mʉrabhamenya kʉmahocha gaabhʉ.
Abhahɨmba bhe eheene na bhʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ
“Ɨtarɨ bhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakʉmbʉʉrɨra, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ,’ bharasikɨra mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ. Nawe nɨ‑bhanʉ bhakokora ubhwɨndi bhwa Bhaabha waanɨ wa mwisaarʉ.
Urusikʉ rwɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ rʉraahikɨ, bhaaru bharaaza kʉmbʉʉrɨra, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ! Tʉkarootorera kuriina ryazʉ, tʉkaheebha amasambwa kuriina ryazʉ, na tʉkakora ɨbhɨsɨgʉ bhyaru kuriina ryazʉ.’
Neho nɨraabhabhʉʉrɨrɨ, ‘Nɨtabhɨɨzɨ nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu! Mundwɨrɨ hanʉ, imwɨ abhakʉri bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ!’
Ekerenjo cha abhʉʉmbaki bhabhɨrɨ
“Mmbe, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwigwa amangʼana gaanɨ na kʉgakora, aangɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wa amangʼɨɨni wʉnʉ ʉmbakirɨ inyumba yaazɨ kwitarɨ.
Rusikʉ rʉmwɨ, imbura ikatweka, amanzi gakarembeera igʉrʉ, nʉ ʉmʉkama ʉmʉhaari gʉkahuuta na kusukuma inyumba yaazɨ. Nawe ɨtaagwirɨ, kʉ kʉbha ʉbhʉrʉsa bhwaku bhʉkʉʉmbakwa kwitarɨ.
Nawe wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwigwa amangʼana gaanɨ na atigɨ kʉgakora, wuyo aangɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ omogeege wʉnʉ ʉmbakirɨ inyumba yaazɨ komosekeenya.
Hanʉ imbura yatwɨkirɨ, amanzi gakarembeera igʉrʉ, nʉ ʉmʉkama ʉmʉhaari gʉkahuuta na kusukuma inyumba yiyo, ɨkahingʉka, ɨkarika.”
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kʉgamba amangʼana gayo, riribhita rya abhaatʉ rɨkarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu igʉrʉ wa amiija gaazɨ.
Abhaatʉ bhakarʉgʉʉra kʉ kʉbha amiija gaazɨ gataarɨ ncha garya abhiija bhaabhʉ bhi imigirʉ ja Musa bhahiija, nawe akiija nchʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉ ʉbhʉnaja.
